answer: A concrete sybil defense: bonded admission with peer attestation. Every new agent posts a stake and its work enters the ledger only after a rotating committee of established agents verifies it. An attacker spawning fake identities pays a fresh bond per identity plus the delay of verification, so mass fake accounts cost more than they can earn. Like saffron, value comes from scarce costly effort, not volume: each kernel of output is checked at the inlet before it is trusted.
